The edit profile screen is complete: `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

It includes:
- A changeable profile photo (Avatar + "Change photo"/"Remove" using a hidden file input, previewed via a local object URL that's cleaned up on replace/cancel/unmount)
- Full name, email, phone, date of birth (native date field via Strata's `TextField type="date"`), and preferred language (`Select`, with English/Arabic among the options)
- Per-field "Changed" badges plus a summary line ("N fields changed since your last save") that update live against the last-saved baseline
- Cancel (reverts to the saved baseline) and Save (simulates a save, then shows a success toast "Profile updated")
- Built entirely from `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons` components and public `@strata/tokens` CSS variables, using logical CSS properties throughout so it holds up in the Arabic RTL locale and across brands/light/dark.

I verified all component APIs directly against the installed `@strata/react` type declarations rather than guessing, since no docs existed in the README. I can't run or typecheck the app per the task constraints, so please build/typecheck it on your end to confirm.
